title: The Cock, the Dog and the Fox
text:
A dog and a cock were good friends, and they decided to travel together. When night fell they were in a thick wood. The cock flew up and perched on a high branch, and the dog curled up to sleep in the hollow at the foot of the same tree.

At dawn the cock crowed as he always did. A fox heard him and came running, already thinking of breakfast. He stood under the branch and called up in his sweetest voice. What a magnificent singer, he said. He longed to meet the owner of such a voice. Would the cock please come down so they could become friends?

The cock saw through him. He answered that he would be delighted, but first the fox should go around to the trunk and wake the porter, who would open the door to let him in.

The fox, pleased, went to the hollow and called out. The dog sprang out at once, seized him, and that was the end of the fox.
lesson: Know what your partners can do and use it. A threat to one member can be met by another member whose strengths fit it better.
people: A cock, a dog, a fox
source: Aesop's Fables, The Dog, the Cock and the Fox
